scope: MovieSift bounded final quality pass F1–F9
executionSource: Committed runtime/test code; only documentation/images pending in the worktree during local validation. No portable or native binary was exercised.

F1.before: Journal-directory collision left the private directory; a separate controlled temporary-identity capture failure also reproduced before its guard.
F1.after: Operation-owned directory/file identities persist until durable journal handoff; rollback preserves foreign/changed paths and reports cleanup independently.

F2.before: Four initial Core/Application NoChange cases failed on unused missing/invalid/existing destinations.
F2.after: NoChange validates container/selection/source but skips output-only checks; actual outputs protect every source and collide only with actual outputs.

F3.before: Language read failure prevented Run despite valid Review and healthy media storage.
F3.after: Session-only preference notice and revision-bound recovery are separate from required data/ownership blocking.

F4.after: Opaque semantic muted brush; actual composed-control tests meet the unchanged 4.5:1 threshold in both languages/themes/custom case.

F5.before: Expanded minimum EN/RU shelf left a 0px track viewport.
F5.after: Bounded scrolling/clipping leaves reachable file/track/footer controls; actual headless geometry and hit targets checked.

F6.before: Opening Appearance left focus outside its covered cosmetic scope.
F6.after: View-level focus cycle, Escape cosmetic close, return focus and mandatory-decision precedence; media lifecycle unchanged.

F7.change: Existing subtitle removal exposed as one reversible atomic section action; duplicate/unknown/fourth-file-only occurrences included; excluded/completed/unrelated state preserved.
F7.authority: Existing SetTrackSelection only; no automatic Review/Run, no second selection store; concrete localized accessible names.

F8.change: Meaningful Application/Desktop/eight integration setups migrated to public selection/destination editing plus ReviewSelectionsAsync before obsolete APIs/presentation were removed.

F9.before: Original incomplete Windows acquisition command reproduced exit 1 before creating tools, because verified source-build input was absent.
F9.after: User-oriented README; complete OS-specific artifact/prerequisite/cache/fixture instructions; current normative scope and immutable historical evidence links.

ordinaryCSharp.meaning: Optional local media cases and platform-only skips do not establish mandatory media coverage.

python.inputs: Complete pinned FFmpeg/zlib source archives SHA256-checked against current lock. Initial missing-input failure resolved by explicit provisioning; no assertion or gate weakened.

realMkvIntegration.evidence: Production rule Preview/Apply where applicable and current ReviewSelectionsAsync; existing retained payload, metadata, source-hash, exited-worker and owned-cleanup assertions passed.
realMkvIntegration.toolsSource: Previously verified source-built Windows workers reused only as explicit test inputs, not old application acceptance.
realMkvIntegration.limit: Current MovieSift FFmpeg/compiler absent locally; full MP4/mixed and target package workflows are mandatory CI scope.

headless.method: Actual Avalonia.Headless input/layout controls and Skia offscreen raster; controlled nonprivate metadata.
headless.geometry: Scroll viewports, complete editable-checkbox bounds/hit target and unobscured footer checked while shelf remains expanded after deterministic headless frame flush.

independentReview.method: Cross-review by separate implementers covering F1–F9 plus root final diff review; evidence-backed findings resolved within this delivery.
